name: Essentials of Information Technology
objectives: Gain understanding of IT fundamentals, software, hardware, networking, and cyber security.
Apply practical skills in data management, application development, and problem -solving for both
Develop essential professional skills such as communication, critical thinking, and an entrepreneurial
mindset for roles in diverse IT-driven environments.

modules.title: Data Storage
topics: Bits and Their Storage, Main Memory, Mass Storage, Representing
Information as Bit Patterns, The Binary System, Storing Integers, Storing Fractions.
Data Manipulation: Computer Architecture, Machine Language, Program Execution,
Arithmetic/Logic Instructions, Communicating with Other Devices.
Text book1:Chapter-1(1.1-1.7),Chapter-2(2.1-2.5)

modules.title: Operating  Systems
topics: The History of Operating Systems, Operating System Architecture,
Coordinating the Machine’s Activities, Handling Competition Among Processes, Security.
Algorithms: The Concept of an Algorithm, Algorithm Representation, Algorithm Discovery.
Textbook1:Chapter-3,Chapter-5(5.1-5.3)

modules.title: Networking and the Internet
topics: Network Fundamentals, The Internet,The World Wide Web,
Internet Protocols, Security.
Cyber security: Overview—What is Cyber security?, Brief History of Cyber security Events,
The Basic Information Security Model, Cyber Hygiene, Teams in Cybersecurity.
Ethical Issues in Information Technology: Overview, Ownership Rules, Ethics and Online
Content.
Textbook1:Chapter-4
Textbook2:Chapter-16,Chapter-17

modules.title: Software Engineering
topics: The Software Engineering Discipline, The Software Life Cycle,
Software Engineering Methodologies, Modularity, Tools of the Trade.
Database Systems: Database Fundamentals, The Relational Model.
Textbook1: Chapter-7(7.1-7.5),Chapter-9(9.1-9.2)

modules.title: Introduction to HTML and Website Development
topics: What is HTML? Cascading Style
Sheets (CSS), Website Design and Story boarding, Structure of a Website.
Computer Graphics: The Scope of Computer Graphics, Overview of 3D Graphics,
Modeling, Rendering.
Text book 2 : Chapter-12. Text book 1: Chapter-10(10.1-10.4)

course_outcomes: CO1 Illustrate data storage and manipulation concepts.
CO2 Explain the knowledge of operating systems and illustrate the use of algorithms for problem
CO3 Discuss network and Internet concepts, identify role of cyber security and ethical issues in IT.
CO4 Apply basic software engineering concepts and construction.
CO5 Illustrate HTML, CSS for website development and learn basic concepts of computer Graphics.
